description:
No spec subject yet (likely advances specled.verification when fixed).

Extracted from specled_-epl comments during 2026-07-24 board triage — the tempfile_command_execution race matched no open ticket and is distinct from the tracer_test.exs:241 flake epl tracks.

Observed 3x during epic specled_-155 (2026-07-23), all on otherwise-green runs:
1. Merge gate 1 mix test: stray "specled_cmd_*.sh: No such file or directory"
2. T3 verify mix test --stale: same signature
3. T7 verify spec.check run 1: exit 127 "exs: command not found" on UNTOUCHED evidence_store target.sh — passed manually and on runs 2-3

Hypothesis: cross-VM temp-script name collision in verifier.ex run_command — when a host project test suite spawns nested specled runs (or parallel verifications share a temp dir), two BEAMs can generate the same specled_cmd_* name; one deletes the script while the other is executing it, producing exit 127 / missing-file failures attributed to innocent subjects.

Impact: false verification_command_failed findings from mix spec.check — the core promise failing — in any host project whose tests spawn nested specled runs.

Fix direction: make the temp-script name collision-proof (OS pid + random bytes) in verifier.ex run_command, plus a regression test. Optionally surface the merged-run ExUnit seed line into spec.check CI output for diagnosability (also referenced by specled_-epl / specled_-qvg protocol).
